available_scenarios.description: The same panel photographed twice with no change. The pipeline must report nothing; if it reports something here, it is producing false positives.
available_scenarios.label: No damage - identical conditions
available_scenarios.name: clean

available_scenarios.description: The pickup photo is 18% brighter, as if a cloud moved. Nothing changed on the vehicle. This is the scenario the lighting normalisation and diffuse-region filters exist to survive.
available_scenarios.label: Lighting change only - no damage
available_scenarios.name: lighting_only

available_scenarios.description: A thin scuff drawn along the lower door. Exercises the elongated, edge-dominant branch of the labeller.
available_scenarios.label: Scratch along the front door
available_scenarios.name: scratch

available_scenarios.description: A shading depression with no colour change. Exercises the dark-and-achromatic branch.
available_scenarios.label: Dent on the front wing
available_scenarios.name: dent

available_scenarios.description: A warm, mottled colour shift. Exercises the chroma channel, which is the only one that can see this at all.
available_scenarios.label: Rust patch on the lower wing
available_scenarios.name: rust

detections.detection_reasoning: Region flagged as a potential change: mean difference 85.5 (threshold 22.0), peak 134.0, covering 0.39% of the frame. Labelled SCRATCH because the region is thin and stretched (aspect ratio 12.5, fill 0.75) and the change is concentrated in new edges rather than in colour. This label is a heuristic reading of shape and colour statistics, not a classification by a trained model, and needs human confirmation. Mapped from the middle-centre third of a left side view, using a 3x3 grid. This is a coarse geometric mapping, not part segmentation.

detections.detection_reasoning: Region flagged as a potential change: mean difference 73.2 (threshold 22.0), peak 123.2, covering 0.26% of the frame. Labelled PAINT_CHIP because a compact region became noticeably brighter (delta L +86.1) with a colour shift of 58.0, consistent with bare substrate showing through paint. This label is a heuristic reading of shape and colour statistics, not a classification by a trained model, and needs human confirmation. Mapped from the middle-left third of a left side view, using a 3x3 grid. This is a coarse geometric mapping, not part segmentation.

region_mapping.basis: Mapped from the middle-left third of a left side view, using a 3x3 grid. This is a coarse geometric mapping, not part segmentation.

detections.detection_reasoning: Region flagged as a potential change: mean difference 37.1 (threshold 22.0), peak 75.4, covering 0.35% of the frame. Labelled DENT because a localised region changed brightness substantially (mean absolute delta L 24.4) with no colour change (chroma 11.9), which is how a depression reads: it alters how the panel catches light without altering the paint. Bipolar shading scores 0.14, which is lower than a textbook depression would give, so this label is weak. This label is a heuristic reading of shape and colour statistics, not a classification by a trained model, and needs human confirmation. Mapped from the lower-right third of a left side view, using a 3x3 grid. This is a coarse geometric mapping, not part segmentation.

region_mapping.basis: Mapped from the lower-right third of a left side view, using a 3x3 grid. This is a coarse geometric mapping, not part segmentation.
